+WP1052 (phase A): new reference `references/windows-testing.md` describes how to build and test the skill
+on Windows through Desktop Commander: which machine to pick (the `tra-luat-win` Compute Engine VM by
+default, the owner's ASUS laptop only for compatibility/UI checks), the preflight to run before any write
+or test (explicit `deviceId`, hostname, account, PowerShell, source SHA, a separate write area per run),
+the read-only `ping` check, the VM lifecycle commands, and the data-protection rules. Its first paragraph
+states that Desktop Commander is only a transport and does not replace a Packet, a lease or the release
+gate. `SKILL.md` gains one pointer line and one row in DANH MỤC REFERENCES and nothing else: the kernel
+had 404 B left under the 48,128 B ceiling locked by `r142_corpus_first_invariant`, and the full operating
+paragraph would have overshot it by 45 B, so it lives at the top of the reference instead. `SKILL.md`
+goes from 47,724 B to 47,925 B (203 B left); `references/GOTCHAS.md` records the new size. Phase B
+updated the `workflow_audit` golden (`kernel.size_bytes` 47,724 → 47,925, `kernel.links_checked` 15 →
+16). The manifest and the package file count landed together once packet wp1039 released
+`RELEASE_MANIFEST.json`: `tl_selftest.py` now pins 197 package files (195 plus this reference and this
+fragment) at both places, and the regenerated manifest passes the LAND-lane `release-verify --strict`
+with 197/197. Revision 4 aligns the reference with ADR-0057, ADR-0058 and ADR-0059: a pointer to the
+machine lock, the measurement log and the per-session folder, each machine's `tl-win` root (`D:\tl-win`
+on the laptop, `C:\tl-win` on the VM), `gcloud` limited to the VM lifecycle, and the Commander file-tool
+allowlist as measured with `get_config` on 2026-10-31 (the laptop now also allows `D:\tl-win`; the VM has
+no allowlist). Revision 5 comes from running the reference on the `tra-luat-win` VM on 2026-10-31 under
+the ADR-0057 to ADR-0059 lock: every preflight command worked, and on a fresh HTTPS clone at `ad0cbb5`
+the selftest passed 1774/1774 (785 s; one fragment, `wp726_script_nlm_canary`, skips by design on
+Windows) with golden-test, workflow-audit, doc-claims-check, determinism-audit and the worker-lane
+release-verify at rc 0. Two small fixes follow from that run: the hostname check is now case-insensitive
+(`hostname` prints lower case), and the reference now says that reading the repository over HTTPS works
+on the VM. Not measured: the ASUS laptop path.

+# Windows testing qua Desktop Commander
+
+Test/build trên Windows qua Desktop Commander: đọc tệp này. Mặc định dùng tra-luat-win; ASUS dùng khi cần tương thích/UI. Luôn chọn deviceId, kiểm hostname/source SHA và tách vùng ghi mỗi run. Commander là transport, không thay Packet/lease hay release gate.
